title: Worker launch request gate
goal: Expose the fresh execution lease and admit a separate digest-bound worker-launch request without starting the worker.
laws: Only an unexpired LEASE_READY_NOT_STARTED lease may request launch.
Mission ID, builder ID, lease ID and lease SHA-256 are bound into the request.
Expired, mismatched, or already-started leases fail closed.
Trust Canal admission of launch request is not worker execution.
Command Centre exposes lease and launch-request state truthfully.
No Qwen/model/worker launch occurs in this mission.
